name: Menemen
description: Eggs scrambled into a sizzling pan of tomatoes, green peppers, and olive oil for Turkey's ultimate brunch.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Gather and prep the bulgur wheat and red lentils, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat unsalted butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the sliced scallions and red onions, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the red lentils, season with sweet paprika, and cook until just done, about 10 mins.
Warm the bulgur wheat alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the bulgur wheat and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of parsley just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
Prep the bulgur wheat and red lentils the night before to make busy mornings much easier.
